final: WITH per_race_stats AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) as avg_points, AVG(wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall_avg_wins AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg_wins FROM per_race_stats WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL) SELECT per_race_stats.raceId, per_race_stats.avg_points, per_race_stats.avg_wins, per_race_stats.avg_wins - overall_avg_wins.overall_avg_wins as difference FROM per_race_stats, overall_avg_wins WHERE overall_avg_wins.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN (per_race_stats.avg_wins - overall_avg_wins.overall_avg_wins) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, (per_race_stats.avg_wins - overall_avg_wins.overall_avg_wins) DESC LIMIT 10
